revised_document:
**Without prejudice — settlement counterproposal**

We acknowledge your rejection of INR 2,000,000 and your counteroffer of INR 3,200,000. Our client is prepared to renew the INR 2,000,000 settlement proposal, subject to the client’s final approval and execution of a written settlement agreement. The settlement would carry no confidentiality restriction; neither party would be required to keep its terms confidential.

Please confirm whether your client will accept this proposal. Any reports to either client must accurately disclose the material settlement terms, including the amount and the absence of a confidentiality obligation. We cannot agree to omit those terms from client reports.
